steps.title: Prepare LB medium
steps.instruction: Weigh 25 g LB powder, add water to 1 L, autoclave.

steps.title: Prepare streptomycin stock (50 mg/ml)
steps.instruction: Weigh 2.5 g streptomycin sulfate, dissolve in 50 ml water, filter through 0.22 µm PES filter, aliquot and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M IPTG stock
steps.instruction: Weigh 11.9 g IPTG, dissolve in 50 ml water, filter through 0.22 µm PES filter, aliquot and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 5 mM biotin stock
steps.instruction: Heat ~50 °C PBS, dissolve 84 mg biotin in 70 ml heated PBS, filter through 0.22 µm PES filter, cool to < 37 °C, use fresh.

steps.title: Prepare 100 mM TCEP stock (pH 8.0)
steps.instruction: Prepare 0.5 M NaHCO₃ (pH 9.0) in water, weigh 2.87 g TCEP·HCl, fill to 100 ml with NaHCO₃ solution, adjust pH to 8.0 with NaOH, aliquot and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer (pH 8.0)
steps.instruction: Mix 100 mM HEPES, 500 mM NaCl, 20 mM imidazole, 5 % (v/v) glycerol; add 0.5 mM TCEP from freshly prepared TCEP stock immediately before use; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare elution buffer (pH 8.0)
steps.instruction: Mix 50 mM HEPES, 500 mM NaCl, 500 mM imidazole, 5 % (v/v) glycerol; add 0.5 mM TCEP from freshly prepared TCEP stock immediately before use; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare protein buffer
steps.instruction: Use PBS supplemented with 0.5 mM TCEP added from TCEP stock immediately before use; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 1 mg/ml BSA standard
steps.instruction: Weigh 500 mg BSA, dissolve in 500 ml water, aliquot and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 5× SDS loading buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 0.31 M Tris‑HCl (pH 6.8), 50 % (v/v) glycerol, 10 % (w/v) SDS, 12.5 % (v/v) 2‑mercaptoethanol, 0.05 % (w/v) bromophenol blue; aliquot and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare zinc solution (1 mM)
steps.instruction: Dissolve zinc acetate dihydrate to 1 mM in water; store as indicated.

steps.title: Prepare Coomassie staining solution
steps.instruction: Mix 10 % (v/v) acetic acid, 25 % (v/v) 2‑propanol, 0.1 % (w/v) Coomassie brilliant blue R‑250; store as indicated.

steps.title: Prepare destaining solution
steps.instruction: Mix 10 % (v/v) acetic acid with 20 % (v/v) ethanol; store as indicated.

steps.title: Prepare blocking buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 3 % (w/v) BSA in PBS; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare washing buffer
steps.instruction: Add 0.05 % (v/v) Tween 20 to PBS; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare beads buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1 % (w/v) BSA to PBS; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare ampicillin stock (100 mg/ml)
steps.instruction: Weigh 5 g ampicillin sodium salt, dissolve in 50 ml water, filter through 0.22 µm PES filter, aliquot and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare chloramphenicol stock (34 mg/ml)
steps.instruction: Weigh 1.7 g chloramphenicol, dissolve in 50 ml ethanol, store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Transform BL21 Star (DE3) with pMH1105
steps.instruction: Thaw 50 µl competent BL21 Star (DE3) on ice, add 1 µl pMH1105 plasmid (10–1000 ng/µl), tap gently, incubate on ice 20 min, heat‑shock 42 °C 45 s, ice 2 min, add 500 µl LB, shake 37 °C 750 rpm 1 h.

steps.title: Select transformants overnight
steps.instruction: Transfer cells to 50 ml tube containing 10 ml LB + 100 µg/ml streptomycin, incubate ~15 h at 37 °C, 150 rpm.

steps.title: Prepare pre‑culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 100 ml LB + 100 µg/ml streptomycin in 500 ml baffled flask with overnight culture, grow 4 h at 37 °C, 150 rpm.

steps.title: Scale‑up expression cultures
steps.instruction: Inoculate six 2 L baffled flasks each containing 1 L LB + 100 µg/ml streptomycin with 10 ml pre‑culture, grow at 30 °C, 150 rpm to OD₆₀₀ 0.6–0.8 (measure against LB blank).

steps.title: Induce protein expression
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml 1 M IPTG (final 1 mM) and 10 ml 5 mM biotin (final 50 µM) to each 1 L culture, incubate 20 h at 18 °C, 150 rpm in the dark.

steps.title: Harvest and freeze cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge cultures 6,500 × g 10 min 4 °C, resuspend pellets in lysis buffer (30 ml per L culture), aliquot into 50 ml conical tubes, shock‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Thaw and lyse cells
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen tubes in 37 °C water bath, keep on ice, lyse by three passes through a French press at 1,000–1,500 bar.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge lysate 30,000 × g 30 min 4 °C; keep supernatant for purification.

steps.title: IMAC purification (Ni‑NTA)
steps.instruction: Mount Ni‑NTA Superflow column on Äkta (4 °C), set flow 5 ml/min, monitor 280 nm; load ~90 ml lysate (≈3 L culture), wash with 100 ml lysis buffer (20 CV), elute with 50 ml elution buffer (10 CV), collect ~2 ml fractions, pool turquoise fractions.

steps.title: Optional concentration after IMAC
steps.instruction: Concentrate pooled eluate using 10 kDa centrifugal concentrator at 8,000 × g (if desired).

steps.title: Buffer exchange via desalting column
steps.instruction: Connect HiPrep 26/10 desalting column to Äkta (4 °C), flow 10 ml/min; equilibrate with 200 ml protein buffer, load up to 10 ml concentrated eluate, wash with 200 ml protein buffer, collect ~4 ml fractions for first 50 ml, pool turquoise fractions of the 280 nm peak (exclude conductivity peak).

steps.title: Final concentration and quantification
steps.instruction: Concentrate pooled protein to 1–5 mg/ml at 8,000 × g, determine concentration by Bradford assay using 1 mg/ml BSA standard.

steps.title: Optional glycerol addition and storage
steps.instruction: Add glycerol to 10 % (v/v), aliquot 1.5 ml into microcentrifuge tubes, shock‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, store at –80 °C; thaw at 37 °C when needed, centrifuge 20,000 × g 5 min, keep supernatant at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare samples for SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Mix 80 µl protein (~0.2 mg/ml) with 20 µl 5× SDS loading buffer, incubate 95 °C 5 min.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE and stain (zinc/Coomassie)
steps.instruction: Load samples onto 10–15 % polyacrylamide gel, run SDS‑PAGE; incubate gel 15 min in zinc solution (visualize PCB fluorescence under UV), then 1 h in Coomassie solution, then overnight in destaining solution.

steps.title: Detect biotinylated protein (Western)
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins to PVDF membrane by electroblotting, block 1 h in blocking buffer, incubate with Avidin‑HRP (1:2000 in blocking buffer), wash 3 × 5 min with washing buffer, visualize with ECL reagent on chemiluminescence imager.

steps.title: Estimate biotinylation efficiency (bead assay)
steps.instruction: Transfer 400 µl streptavidin agarose slurry (≈200 µl settled beads) to 1.5 ml tube, pellet 500 × g 3 min; wash 3× with 1 ml beads buffer, centrifuge each wash; resuspend beads in 200 µl beads buffer; dilute PhyB‑AviTag to ~80 µg/ml in beads buffer, aliquot 200 µl into six tubes; add 100 µl beads to three tubes, 100 µl beads buffer to the other three; incubate 1 h mixing every 15 min; pellet beads, transfer 200 µl supernatant from each tube to new tubes; from the remaining beads, transfer 100 µl supernatant to wells of a black 96‑well plate; also add 100 µl PhyB‑AviTag without beads to the same plate; illuminate 3 min with 740 nm light (100 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹); measure fluorescence (excitation 635 nm, emission 680 nm) in the dark; calculate ratio of bead‑sample fluorescence to buffer‑sample fluorescence to estimate non‑biotinylated fraction.

steps.title: Spectral analysis of photoswitching
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µl PhyB‑AviTag (~1 mg/ml) to a UV‑transparent 96‑well plate; illuminate 3 min with 660 nm or 740 nm light (100 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹); measure absorbance spectra from 250–900 nm in 1 nm steps in the dark (dim green light).

steps.title: Produce GFP‑PIF6 (for SEC)
steps.instruction: Transform plasmid pHB111 into BL21 (DE3)pLysS, select with 100 µg/ml ampicillin + 34 µg/ml chloramphenicol, induce as for PhyB‑AviTag, incubate 30 °C 150 rpm 6 h, harvest cells.

steps.title: Mix PhyB‑AviTag and GFP‑PIF6
steps.instruction: Determine concentrations of both proteins by Bradford assay; mix PhyB‑AviTag (~2 mg/ml) with equimolar GFP‑PIF6 in protein buffer to total 800 µl, split into two 1.5 ml tubes.

steps.title: SEC analysis of light‑dependent interaction
steps.instruction: Protect SEC column (Superdex 200 Increase 10/300 GL) with foil, connect to FPLC/Äkta with 200 µl loop; equilibrate with 30 ml protein buffer; for each tube, load protein into a transparent syringe, illuminate 3 min with 660 nm or 740 nm light (100 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹), inject in the dark; run SEC at 1 ml/min, monitor absorbance at 280 nm, 488 nm (GFP) and 671 nm (PhyB); after the sample has entered the column (few ml), room light may be turned on; calibrate column beforehand with gel filtration standard.
